findings.message: Element "e" (endEvent) has 2 incoming flows. Non-gateway elements must have at most one incoming flow.
findings.suggestion: Add an exclusive gateway before this element to join the incoming flows.

findings.message: Service task "t1" has no output variable mapping.
findings.suggestion: Map the job result to process variables so downstream tasks can consume it.

findings.message: Service task "t2" has no output variable mapping.
findings.suggestion: Map the job result to process variables so downstream tasks can consume it.

findings.message: Start event "s" has no documentation describing expected input variables.

findings.message: Job type "my-connector" is used by 2 service tasks.
findings.suggestion: Verify this is intentional — the same worker will handle all these tasks. Consider distinct job types if behaviors differ.

findings.message: Variable "x" is referenced but never set in this process.
findings.suggestion: "x" is never set on any path through this process.

findings.message: Variable "inputVar" is set but never read by any downstream element.
findings.suggestion: Remove the output mapping for "inputVar" or add a task that consumes it.

findings.suggestion: Set isExecutable="true" — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a non-executable process.
